fingerprint.mask_rule: pixel centre inside park; outside set to nodata=0

crop.boundary_rule: pixel centre inside park; outside set to nodata=0

area_statistics.area_method: WGS84 ellipsoidal pixel quadrilateral area, calculated per latitude row; each cell assigned by centre point
area_statistics.vector_area_method: densify lon/lat straight segments to <=0.001 degree, then pyproj.Geod.geometry_area_perimeter on oriented WGS84 rings
area_statistics.valid_coverage_denominator: all region-assigned native cells including nodata; independent vector/raster discrepancy reported
area_statistics.class_share_denominator: valid classified area, not whole region area
area_statistics.fuel_proxy_share_denominators: share_valid uses valid classified area; share_region uses complete assigned footprint including nodata, so use valid_coverage alongside it
area_statistics.fuel_proxy_limitation: Habitat proxy, not measured fuel load or predicted fire probability; wetlands/cropland excluded in baseline
area_statistics.salt_pan_rule: Only independently mapped main_pan is excluded explicitly; class 60 is never synonymous with salt pan

native_grid_sample_verification.method: fixed-seed native-pixel crop/source equality; exterior cells required nodata=0

region_partition_geometry.statistics_clip_rule: all supplied region geometries clipped to park before centre-cell assignment
region_partition_geometry.area_note: True geometric overlap uses pairwise intersections; geodesic sum-minus-union can differ because long rings have different segmentation

limitations: 2021 class map is historical static habitat proxy
Centre-rule boundary pixels; area discrepancy reported
Class 60 is bare / sparse vegetation, not an independent salt-pan map
Fuel proxy is not observed fuel load
